# Test fixtures

`equilibrium_step100/`: one full-core PEARLSim step from a real v1 run (`gFHR_benchmark_1975/`, step 100,
280 MWth, generated by tag `v1-as-run` with Serpent "pre-2.2.1"). Built by `make_fixtures.py`.

| File | Treatment |
|---|---|
| `*_res.m`, `*_det0.m`, `*_det1.m`, `zone_map100.json`, `*_operating_100.json` | copied unchanged |
| `*_discharge_inventory100.json`, `*_discard_inventory100.json` | `concentration(s)` fields removed (the readers never use them) |
| `*.bumat1` | header + first 6 `mat` blocks (of 320) |
| `expected.json` | reader outputs computed from the **full** source files |
| `SOURCES.tsv` | sha256 and size of every source file |

The tests compare reader results on the trimmed copies with `expected.json`. Agreement shows the
trimming did not change what the readers see.

Not used: `raw_seqne_data/` step 10. Its discharge/discard JSONs are two days newer than its Serpent
outputs, because a later sequence overwrote them in the same directory, so the step is internally
inconsistent.
